notes.title: Update v1.1.5 - Quick fix
notes.content:
Small fixes.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug in the World 2 4th Low Gravity Zone, in which one of the locks wasn't connected to the stage portal;
[*] Adjustments on the GGS minigames menu navigation with joystick thumbsticks;
[*] Adjustments on the World 3 planet checkmarks on the Navigation Screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.1.4 - Bugfixes
Astro Pig Released! + Garoa Hits vol. 1
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 This May 1st we've launched Astro Pig - our lo-fi adventure puzzle platformer - on Steam! [/h2]

We're working on a few bugfixes as of now, and we'll upload the updated version soon. If you happen to find any strange behavior or issue, please inform us at support@garoastudios.com !

🚩 We also announce that with AP's launch we've also updated our [b]Garoa Hits - vol. 1[/b] bundle! If you've missed any Garoa classic titles' launch, take a look and grab this chance to complete your collection!

📦 The bundle includes:

[list]
[*] Cartomante (2020)
[*] Stand By Me (2021)
[*] Cat Leather Jackets (2023)
[*] Astro Pig (2024)[/list]
💿 The bundle only adds to your cart titles you don't have in your library, and applies a discount over the total value! We think it's also a great gift for that special someone that enjoys brazilian games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38548/Garoa_Hits__vol_1/?curator_clanid=4777282
